derivations: Other operating expense = gross operating expense minus payroll excluding pensions minus pension expense. Net operating cost excludes depreciation. The reported 2025 total differs by -1 from rounded components; the difference is recorded rather than silently assigned to a service.
comparability: Both years are from the same 2025 report. The 2023 report labels its pension-cost series as excluding payroll tax; those values are intentionally not combined without a definition reconciliation.
